text: Having finished this book, you know Java.
explanation: You have not used the module system, most of the standard library, build tools beyond the basics, or any framework — deliberately, since those are learnable in days when you need them and the ideas in the book are not. What you have is the foundation they sit on, which is a different and more durable thing, and the honest accounting in Section 35.2.2 is more useful than a certificate.
